title: Benchmarking imaging-based inspection techniques for PV systems
mechanism: Fault-centric comparison of IR, EL, UVF, PL and emerging modalities by fault visibility and technology readiness, not by reported accuracy.
evidence: R: IR ML 94 to 98 %, EL DL up to 97.8 %, UVF crack detection > 91 % at 10 to 15x throughput; states these come from different data and protocols and are not comparable.
adaptation: Cite in the benchmark chapter as independent support that published numbers are not comparable; its fault by modality frame structures the EL-to-thermal mapping table.
